recheck.ruling: DCL06-C/2026-10-07/form and /presets (rulings/rules/DCL06-C.md): the oracle labels strict, the presumption with no exempt set; EX1 only where the constant is itself the abstraction; array dimensions in declarations FP per P/lists case 3

notes:
A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. mbedtls DCL06-C labels carried forward from mbedtls-oracle-build-r720-20260914, which predates the 2026-10-07 rulings, re-read under them: library/gcm.c through library/net_sockets.c in file order.

RULING. rulings/rules/DCL06-C.md: the oracle labels strict (P/oracle-scope); strict is the presumption with no exempt set (DCL06-C/2026-10-07/form, /presets); EX1 applies only where the constant is itself the abstraction; an array dimension in a declaration is FP after CERT's own sizeof compliant solution, with the violation at dependent uses (P/lists case 3). This is the reading calibrated in delta-dcl06c-2026-10-curl-mbedtls-sqlite and applied in the later 2026-10 DCL06-C batches. A changed reading relabels: the earlier FPs rested on domain-standard, algorithm-inherent, self-evident or comment-documented values, spec constants or no stated basis, none of which the presumption admits; the earlier TPs on declaration dimensions predate P/lists case 3.

SCOPE. Every carried-forward TP or FP DCL06-C row in these files. 2 keys with the literal in a preprocessor condition (library/gcm.c:476, library/net_sockets.c:42) are held and left as they are, pending the separate question of literals in preprocessor conditionals. 4 of the rows are not reported by aurora-lint ca6fd5f3f and are labeled on their merits, as the provenance says.

METHOD. Every row was read at source at the pinned commit (corpus-check: mbedtls at its pin) by a reader under a written brief, against a mechanical draft (declaration dimension, const-qualified initializer, preprocessor condition, otherwise the presumption), and reviewed. A fresh-context reviewer re-read a stratified sample.

RESULT. 136 rows reviewed: FP->TP 97, TP->FP 0, FP kept 36 and TP kept 3 with their reasons restated. FP bases: array dimensions in declarations 24, const-qualified object fields 9, EX1 3.

Mechanics: in-place edits keep each key; the original batch takes a row_count decrement and a superseded_rows record. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
